name: case-studies
description: Customer-story slider: a white testimonial card overlapping a large photo, with arrows, a rule and dots below. Figma: Home Page > Case Studies (4331:24818).

cta_label.description: Header link text, e.g. View All Case Studies. Renders only with cta_url.

items.description: Slides. Each: title (required); optional category, quote, author, role, logo, logo_alt, image, image_alt, link_label, link_url.

autoplay_ms.description: Milliseconds between automatic slide changes (default 3000; 0 turns autoplay off; values under 1500 are raised to 1500). Autoplay pauses on hover, keyboard focus, touch, a playing video, an off-screen slider and a hidden tab, and never runs under prefers-reduced-motion.
